visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a female staff member standing behind a dark cinema counter. She wears a black polo shirt with a red logo and a surgical mask. Behind her, multiple large digital display screens glow with movie schedules and advertisements. Her hands are resting near a computer monitor on the counter. (2) The camera pans to reveal two young men in vibrant cosplay outfits. The person on the left has bright pink spiky hair, blue geometric line markings painted on his chest and face, and wears a small purple vest. The person on the right has a red headband, a red boxy vest, and white baggy pants with a green sash. (3) The cosplayers strike exaggerated martial arts poses, extending their hands toward the camera while maintaining serious facial expressions. The background shows the cinema lobby's red and black geometric wall panels. (4) A brief graphic of a green cartoon character pops up over the scene. The camera cuts back to the female staff member, who remains motionless with a neutral expression, staring at the individuals. (5) The two cosplayers break their poses and begin to smile and laugh while looking toward the counter. One points a finger as they continue their interaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a polite, service-oriented female voice speaking in Mandarin, set against a cheerful, upbeat acoustic guitar background track. The guitar maintains a steady rhythm with light percussion. (2) A male voice responds with a questioning 'Hah?', followed by a second male voice with an exaggerated, mock-confused tone. The BGM remains consistent in volume. (3) A sharp, high-pitched comedic 'HA' sound effect punctuates the conversation. One male speaker delivers the punchline 'Fantastic Four' in a deadpan yet confident voice. (4) The track concludes with the sound of collective laughter and the BGM continuing at the same energy level until the end of the recording.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic social media skit where cosplayers visit a cinema. The humor stems from the juxtaposition of their highly specific anime/gaming costumes with their absurd claim that they are members of the Fantastic Four, leaving the cinema employee visibly bewildered.
